INSERT INTO public.tb_middle_person (job_no, name, person_type, sex, org_id, mobile, cert_type, certificate_no, status, update_time) VALUES
(#{item.jobNo}, #{item.name}, #{item.personType}, #{item.sex}, #{item.orgId}, #{item.mobile}, #{item.certType}, #{item.certificateNo}, #{item.status}, now() )
ON CONFLICT (certificate_no) DO UPDATE SET job_no = EXCLUDED.job_no, name = EXCLUDED.name, person_type = EXCLUDED.person_type, sex = EXCLUDED.sex, org_id = EXCLUDED.org_id, mobile = EXCLUDED.mobile, cert_type = EXCLUDED.cert_type, certificate_no = EXCLUDED.certificate_no, status = EXCLUDED.status, update_time = now()

INSERT INTO public.tb_middle_org (org_id, org_name, parent_org_id, status, update_time) VALUES
(#{item.orgId}, #{item.orgName}, #{item.parentOrgId}, #{item.status}, #{item.updateTimeStr} )
ON CONFLICT (org_id) DO UPDATE SET org_id = EXCLUDED.org_id, org_name = EXCLUDED.org_name, parent_org_id = EXCLUDED.parent_org_id, status = EXCLUDED.status, update_time = EXCLUDED.update_time

INSERT INTO public.tb_middle_face (job_no, face_data, face_url, status, update_time, certificate_no) VALUES
(#{item.jobNo}, #{item.faceData}, #{item.faceUrl}, #{item.status}, now(), #{item.certificateNo} )
ON CONFLICT (certificate_no) DO UPDATE SET job_no = EXCLUDED.job_no, face_data = EXCLUDED.face_data, face_url = EXCLUDED.face_url, status = EXCLUDED.status, update_time = now(), certificate_no = EXCLUDED.certificate_no
